SELECT COUNT(*) calls, COUNT(DISTINCT c.PRSCRBR_ME) prs, SUM(IFF(p.PRSCRBR_ME IS NULL,1,0)) unmatched, COUNT(DISTINCT c.REP_ID) reps, SUM(IFF(r.REP_ID IS NULL,1,0)) rep_unmatched
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = c.PRSCRBR_ME
LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r ON r.REP_ID = c.REP_ID

WITH de AS (
  SELECT r.PRSCRBR_ME, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) trx_12m,
         SUM(IFF(r.WK_END_DT > (SELECT DATEADD(week,-13,MAX(WK_END_DT)) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY), r.TRX_QTY,0)) trx_13w
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
  GROUP BY 1),
calls AS (
  SELECT c.PRSCRBR_ME, MAX(c.CALL_DT) last_call,
         SUM(IFF(c.CALL_DT >= '2026-07-02',1,0)) calls_90d,
         LISTAGG(DISTINCT IFF(c.CALL_DT >= '2026-07-02', rr.TEAM, NULL), ',') teams_90d
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER rr ON rr.REP_ID=c.REP_ID GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.DECILE, COUNT(*) n_pr, SUM(IFF(de.PRSCRBR_ME IS NOT NULL AND de.trx_12m>0,1,0)) dry_eye_writers,
       SUM(IFF(de.trx_12m>0 AND COALESCE(ca.calls_90d,0)=0,1,0)) uncalled_de
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p LEFT JOIN de ON de.PRSCRBR_ME=p.PRSCRBR_ME LEFT JOIN calls ca ON ca.PRSCRBR_ME=p.PRSCRBR_ME

  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
